actual: BUG-205 aftercare exposed a workflow defect: run --mode merge created close-sync PR #555, then merge-finalizer retries after TLS timeout and source worktree cleanup appended duplicate close-sync commits and could fail with 'is not a working tree' after the source worktree had already been removed. The workflow should reuse an existing open close-sync PR/branch for the same BUG/source PR, avoid duplicate registry commits when BUG JSON content is unchanged, and treat an already-unregistered/absent source worktree as cleanup-complete when the merged source PR verifies the branch is safe. This keeps merge -> close-sync -> root sync -> cleanup retry-safe without root pollution or manual intervention.
closure_requirements: merge-finalizer retries reuse an existing open close-sync PR/branch for the same BUG/source PR instead of appending duplicate registry commits when BUG JSON content is unchanged.
cleanup treats an already-unregistered or already-absent source worktree as cleanup-complete when the merged source PR verifies branch safety.
Regression tests cover idempotent close-sync PR reuse and missing-worktree cleanup retry.
Run required workflow validation without touching production runtime or DB.
